title: Extensionality over the prime index for the zeta ratio identity
intent: Reduce the equality between the zeta ratio and an Euler product over primes to a pointwise equality over the prime index p (via congr/ext), then close the single pointwise factor with the ratio identity (1 - p^{-2s})^{-1}/(1 - p^{-s})^{-1} = (1 + p^{-s})^{-1}.

consequences: The move turns one product equality into one pointwise goal per index (here a single p, bound by ext). It depends on a prior rewrite (zeta_ratios) putting the two sides into the same product shape; ext only applies because both sides are products over the same index type P. If the pointwise factor does not close by one named lemma (as ratio_invs does here), the per-index goal needs a further split, and the move does not help with that.
